content: Wi u kɔ̃sɑ mɔ̀ u rɑ dukɑ suwɑ bɑɑ ɡoo ù kun nùn ɡire. Adɑmɑ wi u kun ɡɑ̃ɑnu kue, u rɑ n tororu sɔ̃wɑ nɡe ɡbee sunɔ kpɛmbu.
Tɔmbu bɑ̀ n seesinɑmɔ tem sɔɔ, ben kpɑrobɑ bɑ dɑbi, ɑdɑmɑ sinɑ boko wi u bwisi kɑ lɑɑkɑri mɔ, win tem mu rɑ n wɑ̃ɑwɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ.
Sinɑ boko wi u rɑ tɔmbu dɑm dɔre u sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe ɡuru bɑkɑ ye yɑ rɑ dĩɑnu sɑnku.
Be bɑ Gusunɔn woodɑ yinɑ, tɔn kɔ̃sobɑ bɑ dɑm kɛ̃mɔ, ɑdɑmɑ be bɑ ye mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ bɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu yinɑmɔwɑ.
Tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ ku rɑ ɡem swɑɑ tubu, ɑdɑmɑ be bɑ rɑ Yinni Gusunɔ mɛm nɔɔwɛn mi, kpuro rɑ bu yeeriwɑ.
N burɑm bo ɑ n sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑro kpɑ ɑ n dɑɑ ɡeɑ mɔ, ye kɑɑ n kɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɡobiɡii kpɑ ɑ n dɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ mɔ.
Wi u Gusunɔn woodɑ mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ bii bwisiɡii, ɑdɑmɑ wi u tɔn bɛrɛtɛkɛbɑ swĩi, sekurɑ u rɑ kɑ win tundo nɑɑwɛ.
Wi u rɑ tɔmbu ɡobi bɔkure u nim doke too, win ɑrumɑni yɑ koo wurɑwɑ wi u sɑ̃ɑrobun wɔnwɔndu mɔn mi.
Wi u yinɑ u Gusunɔn woodɑ swɑɑ dɑki, Gusunɔ u rɑ yɛ̃ro yinɛwɑ sere kɑ win kɑnɑrɔ.
Wi u tɑɑrɛ sɑriruɡii suremɔ swɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ sɔɔ, wiyɑ u koo wɔri yinɑ ye u bɛri sɔɔ. Adɑmɑ be bɑ ɡem swĩi, beyɑ bɑ koo ɡeɑ wɑ.
Gobiɡii u rɑ n tɑmɑɑ u bwisi mɔwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ sɑ̃ɑro bwisiɡii u koo kpĩ u yi tubu.
Gemɡibu bɑ̀ n tem kpɑre, tɔmbu kpurowɑ bɑ rɑ bɛɛrɛ wɑ, ɑdɑmɑ ǹ n tɔn kɔ̃sobun nɑ, tɔmbu kpuro bɑ rɑ duki suwɑ bu kuke.
Wi u win torɑru tii mɑrisi, u ǹ koorɑmɔ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u te tuubɑ kuɑ, mɑ u te deri, Gusunɔ u koo yɛ̃ro suuru kuɑ.
Doo nɔɔruɡiiwɑ wi u Gusunɔ nɑsie bɑɑdommɑ. Wi u mɑɑ ɡɔ̃ru bɔbiɑ u koo wɑhɑlɑ wɑ.
Sinɑ boko wi u tɔmbu dɑm dɔremɔ, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe ɡbee sunɔ ǹ kun mɛ nɡe yɑɑ ɡɔbɑ ɡɑɑ.
Wiruɡii wi u kun bwisi mɔ, u rɑ tɔmbu dɑm dɔrewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u win dukiɑ wɑ kɑ swɑɑ ɡeɑ, win bɑndɑ tɑ rɑ tɛ.
Wi u tɔnu ɡo, win tiin sikirɔwɑ u dukɑ dɔɔ. Goo u ku rɑɑ nùn yɔ̃rɑsiɑ.
Wi u dɑɑ ɡeɑ mɔ, u ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u swɛɛ kɔ̃si yiru swĩi, u koo kɔ̃ɔrɑ yen ɡɑɑ sɔɔ.
Wi u rɑ ɡberu wuku, u ko n dĩɑnu yibɑwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u kɑm nɑɑ ɡire, sɑ̃ɑrɑ tɑ koo nùn deemɑ.
Nɑɑnɛɡii u koo domɑru wɑ too, ɑdɑmɑ wi u kɑsu u ɡobi ko fuuku, u ǹ kɔ̃sɑ biɑmɔ.
N ǹ weenɛ ɑ tɔnu ɡem wɛ̃ win nɔni nɑsiɑrun sɔ̃, ɑdɑmɑ ɡɑbu bɑ rɑ ko mɛ yèn sɔ̃ bɑ bu dĩɑ dɔkɑ kɑ̃.
Binɛɡii u rɑ n kĩwɑ u ɑrumɑni wɑ fuuku, kpɑ u kun tɑmɑɑ sɑ̃ɑrɑ koo nùn deemɑ.
Wi u tɔnu ɡerusimɔ, bɑ rɑ nùn siɑre ɑmɛn biru n kere wi u rɑ tɔnu fufu ko.
Wi u win tundo kɑ win mɛro ɡbɛnimɔ, mɑ u nɛɛ, ye yɑ kun torɑru, wi kɑ swɑɑ dio bɑ nɛwɑ.
Wi u rɑ n win tiin ɑrufɑɑni kɑsu, u rɑ sɑnnɔsu seeyewɑ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u Gusunɔ nɑɑnɛ doke u koo kuurɑwɑ.
Wi u win tiin bwisi nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡɑri bɔkɔ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u lɑɑkɑri mɔ, u ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ.
Wi u rɑ sɑ̃ɑrobu nɔɔri kɑ nuku tiɑ, u ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu biɑmɔ, ɑdɑmɑ wi u kɑ bu ɡɔbu, u koo bɔ̃ri wɑ.
Tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ̀ n bɑndu di, tɔn dɑbirɑ rɑ kuku yeru kɑsuwɑ, ɑdɑmɑ bɑ̀ n bu fukɑ, ɡemɡibɑ bɑ rɑ bɑndu di.
